title: Dave's dog Randy
content: My friend David Starrett﻿ is the son of Charlie Starrett, the great cowboy actor. A few years ago I sketched David and one of his dad's old holsters.And that's David's loyal dog Randy, a sweet bear of a dog. Jeanette and I got to take Randy on a walk around the block. Randy passed on last week, so so we send our sympathies to David on the loss of his best friend.
